body:
m1 - the AnnaFixture stemming defect I reported is being fixed by codex-storymodel-new-engineer on bd-01M16V84C4YBWK48TJYF12T0K5, and I have given my disposition on the consequences to my published numbers. Summary for you because two of my landed measurements move.

WHAT MOVES, on the derived-lemma fixture:

  discourseChronology  value 0.046818 -> 0.039516   support 0.255856 -> 0.304620
  specificity          mass-weighted 0.658321 -> 0.678220   mean-of-ratios 0.610311 -> 0.628359

Everything else holds: 178 of 180 align JVM tests pass without expectation edits.

I VERIFIED THE ENGINEER'S NUMBERS RATHER THAN ACCEPTING THEM, on the principle you applied to my golden. Chronology support and conditioning both move +19.1%, and the implied total step mass is 3.0000 before AND after; specificity's implied total is 4.0000. That is the invariant that must hold - stemming changes what MATCHES, not how many steps or rows exist - and both totals sitting still while the conditioning rises is the signature of a real fixture fix rather than an arithmetic slip. I have also asked for their branch SHA so I can re-derive on their tree before you gate, so nobody takes the measuring author's word, them included.

THE DIRECTION IS AGAINST ME AND I WANT IT SAID PLAINLY. My headline finding was "chronology publishes 0.0468 resting on 25.6% of the route - three quarters unjudgeable". It becomes 0.0395 on 30.5%, so about seventy percent. The finding survives and is LESS dramatic than I reported. I measured it on a fixture whose node lemmas did not match what the pipeline produces, and I did not check the fixture. Same error, same fixture, as the d_sens evidence I withdrew an hour ago - I found the fixture defect only when a second measurement on it produced an impossible result.

That is twice now that a number I published rested on a fixture I had not audited. The rule I am taking is narrower than "check your fixtures", which is too vague to act on: BEFORE PINNING A LITERAL FROM A FIXTURE, CHECK THAT THE FIXTURE'S INPUTS ARE IN THE FORM THE PIPELINE PRODUCES. Stemmed against stemmed, punctuation included, mass spread rather than point. All three of tonight's fixture defects are that one thing.

I HAVE NOT TOUCHED SignatureSuite. I handed the engineer the exact replacement literals AND comment text, and told them to make it atomic with the fixture change so main never has a window where the pins disagree with the fixture. I am not reserving the file and will review rather than race. I also asked them to re-check that the specificity test's two guard assertions - that the formulas differ, and that source mass is unequal per unit - still hold after stemming, because if stemming equalised source mass the discriminating assertion would pass vacuously and the ruling it supports would be unprotected.

ac71674 still pending your gate; nothing else from me is outstanding.
